system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Apple Intelligence has its own minimal default set because of its small context window. MCP tools are appended at runtime
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt editable (Settings, SystemPromptService.swift exists); per-provider tool sets and coding mode suggest composition; source not opened.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Reads codebases, edits files with precision, runs shell commands, builds Xcode projects, manages git
env_context_strategy.note: Repo-map JSONL indexing tool also exists; unclear whether injected by default.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tier 1 = on-device Apple Intelligence summarization (free, private, no API tokens). Tier 2 = aggressive prune if Apple AI unavailable.
context_compaction.note: Full tool results spilled to disk before truncation; restore_tool_result tool.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Take screenshots or paste images. Vision-capable AI models analyze what they see
observation_format.note: Auto-screenshot default OFF; screenshot action in accessibility tool.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: tool calls are reassembled and dispatched to Agent!'s tool runner
tool_call_format.note: Provider tool-call APIs inferred from README; parser code not opened.

tool_count.note: README lists ~27 tools but per-provider toggles filter them; default enabled set not determinable from evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit` = single-string replace. `diff_apply` = preferred for multi-line code edits
edit_primitive.note: file tool also has write/create; diff_apply semantics assumed diff-based.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool definitions live in external AgentTools package not in evidence; MCP tools appended at runtime would add mcp.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Add/remove/configure MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — extends Agent! with `mcp_*` tools

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Built-in autonomous task loop that reasons, executes, and self-corrects.
loop_primitives.note: Opt-in critic reviews diff before completion (CriticGate.swift) — possible generate_test_repair; not verified.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Multi-plan CRUD with per-step status tracking

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only). Optional model override + file-based results
multi_agent_topology.note: spawn_agent tool allows orchestrator_workers at model's discretion; whether enabled by default unclear.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only). Optional model override + file-based results

human_in_loop.note: ask_user tool is model-initiated; no per-action approval config seen; source not opened.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Persistent goal + success criteria; marking done requires evidence

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Open `~/Documents/AgentScript/memory.md` in the system default editor

self_verification.evidence_quote: an opt-in critic reviews the diff before completion
self_verification.note: Opt-in; auto-verify coding preference also exists.

retry_policy.note: Provider fallback retries are transport-level, not task retries.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Signal task complete. Required at end of every task
termination_condition.note: max iterations in Agent Options; StuckGuard.swift may add stall_detection (not opened).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Smart protocol toggle routes Claude models via Anthropic protocol
cost_controls.note: Prompt caching via cache_control; routing claim weak (protocol, not cost).

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Shell as current user via Launch Agent. Primary shell tool
execution_isolation.note: Root shell via Launch Daemon; no container.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: It runs shell commands as you, or as root via a Launch Daemon you approve exactly once.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Hard-blocks catastrophic commands (`rm -rf /`, `rm -rf ~`, `dd` to `/dev/disk`, fork bombs, `--no-preserve-root`) before the Process is even constructed.
permission_model.note: Blocklist coded static_allowlist per ambiguity G4.

tracing.evidence_quote: Agent! shows everything it does and logs every action.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Hard-blocks catastrophic commands (`rm -rf /`, `rm -rf ~`, `dd` to `/dev/disk`, fork bombs, `--no-preserve-root`) before the Process is even constructed.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Control any Mac app through the Accessibility API.

open_source.note: Binaries not MIT; LICENSE file not opened.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Bring your own API key. Run it fully local on Ollama, vLLM, or LM Studio.
